title: scale-2.6m-hosts: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: No scanner's own publication is captured; methods are not stated: VulnCheck, Censys, VirusTotal and Unit 42 figures all come through news outlets. numbers.json n-censys 'measures' ('Hosts whose HTTP response announces a PHP version below the fixed one') is a reasonable inference but no capture states Censys's method. gist-silascutler-censys-query holds only a Censys search URL.
